text:
Asha Kapoor: Heads-up: want to run a compact launch for "MicroForge StarterKit" — 4 short how-tos (notebooks + Docker), one QuickBench explainer, and a 40-min webinar. Objective: OSS installs, GitHub stars, and gated inbound for credits. Keep the assets low-friction. Thoughts?

Ben Liu: Love it. For the how-tos, can we do trio formats: 1) Quick start (5 min), 2) Hands-on Colab (15 min), 3) Ops checklist (1 page). People can pick their level.

Priya Menon: Yes. Also propose a small benchmark called QuickBench that compares FP16 / int8 with caching on/off. Keep the scripts one-file and add a reproducibility flag.

Ethan Ross: I'll own the webinar ops. Suggested run: 15m demo, 15m engineering deep-dive, 10m community Q&A. Keep the demo deterministic and have a recorded fallback.

Nina Flores: I'll draft the launch blog + 3 tweet threads. Headline options: "MicroForge StarterKit: build a production-ready LLM endpoint in 15 minutes" or something punchier. Also need an image for the blog + hero chart for QuickBench.

Asha Kapoor: Audience: devs + platform engineers. CTAs: 1) Clone the repo (no signup) 2) Sign up for webinar (gated) 3) Request Dedicated evaluation (sales follow). We need routing for (2) and (3) with metadata for model/config.

Ben Liu: For forms, recommend HubSpot -> webhook -> internal leads queue. Add hidden fields: model, seq_len, quant, use_case. That helps follow-up personalization.

Ethan Ross: Here's a simple webhook payload mapping we can use. We'll add it to the registration form: ```json
{
  "source":"microforge_webinar",
  "email":"{{email}}",
  "company":"{{company}}",
  "role":"{{role}}",
  "intent":"webinar|starter|dedicated",
  "meta_model":"{{field_model}}",
  "meta_seq_len":"{{field_seq_len}}",
  "meta_quant":"{{field_quant}}"
}
```

Priya Menon: For QuickBench visuals: show tokens/sec (bar chart), p50/p95 latency (two small badges), and cost per 1k tokens. One compact animation showing caching on vs off would be nice.

Nina Flores: I'll make a static hero and an animated gif fallback. Mock by Tuesday. Also will prepare two short email subject lines to A/B.

Asha Kapoor: Marketing timeline idea: content freeze in 9 days, registration live in 11 days, webinar in 19 days. Is that workable?

Ben Liu: Tight but doable. We should prioritize the repo + Colab so people can try before the webinar. That will reduce demo pressure.

Ethan Ross: Ops: I'll add a demo fallback route so the live demo uses a recorded trace if the test infra can't handle it. Also will create a runbook for the host with steps and checkboxes.

Priya Menon: Bench scripting note: include seeds, exact versions, and a --ci flag that outputs CSV for the blog. Keeps the QuickBench reproducible.

Nina Flores: Social plan: 1) announcement thread with hero + bench snapshot 2) 3 spotlight tweets each day leading to webinar 3) follow-up blog + code lab next week. Will draft comms.

Asha Kapoor: Action list:
- Asha: draft long-form blog + email flows (due in 6 days)
- Nina: hero art + social threads (mock Tue)
- Ben: repo + Colab + Dockerfile (due in 7 days)
- Priya: QuickBench script + bench visuals (due in 8 days)
- Ethan: registration routing + demo fallback runbook (due in 4 days)

Ben Liu: Quick note: let's pin an open model variant that's under permissive license and small enough to run on consumer GPUs. I'll add recommended model tags in the README.

Ethan Ross: I'll make sure the registration webhook tags leads with "microforge:webinar" or "microforge:dedicated" so sales can filter.

comm-bot: Event scheduled "MicroForge StarterKit launch planning" on 2024-09-12 11:00 UTC. Attendees: Asha Kapoor, Ben Liu, Priya Menon, Ethan Ross, Nina Flores.

Asha Kapoor: Thanks all. Can we do a 15-min sync in 24 hours to unblock any dependencies? Will post an agenda. :sparkles: 

Ben Liu: Will push initial Colab link tonight. :computer:

Priya Menon: Adding reproducibility checklist to the repo now. :white_check_mark:

Nina Flores: Will drop hero mock in Drive and add copy variants. :art::speech_balloon:

Ethan Ross: I'll publish the routing doc to #eng-sre once the webhook is wired. :gear: 

Asha Kapoor: Great. Closing thread; will reopen with assets. :calendar:
